headline: Checkout now retries short-lived payment connection failures without creating repeat charges.
what_changed: Customers whose payment connection briefly fails will get up to three automatic attempts before checkout fails.
Each attempt keeps the same protection against doing the same thing twice, so a retry should return the original payment rather than charge again.
The payment failure message now retains the gateway’s response category, allowing the checkout to retry only temporary server failures.
good_news: Permanent payment failures are not retried, so invalid cards and similar problems still fail promptly.
The retry delay increases between attempts, which avoids immediately repeating calls to a struggling payment service.
